# First-Time Book Project Setup

Initializing a technical textbook project creates a self-contained compilation ecosystem with specialized asset configuration profiles.

## Initialization Code

To stand up a pristine textbook scaffold inside your working directory, execute:

```bash
# Initialize a new Quarto book project skeleton
quarto create project book my-textbook

# Navigate into the project directory
cd my-textbook

# Initialize local workspace link to VS Code
code .
